nodes.description: A patent document titled "Social medical network for diagnosis assistance" describing a method and system for diagnosis assistance using similarity between medical cases and experts in a common embedding space.

nodes.entity_id: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance
nodes.description: The title of the patent US9589231B2, referring to a network-based approach for assisting medical diagnosis.
nodes.id: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance

nodes.description: A method for diagnosis assistance that generates multidimensional representations, provides query types at differing costs, identifies subsets of cases or experts, and communicates the new case to an expert.<SEP>A method that exploits similarity between a new medical case and existing medical cases and experts embedded in a common embedding space, supporting query-by-cases and query-by-experts.

A multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, and experts are represented as embeddings.<SEP>A common multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, and experts are embedded so their similarity can be computed.

A medical case submitted by a requester for which a diagnosis is sought, embedded in an embedding space.<SEP>A medical case submitted by a requester in a query request, which is embedded in the embedding space to find similar cases or experts.

A set of previously known medical cases embedded in the embedding space and used for similarity comparison.<SEP>A set of previously stored medical cases embedded in the embedding space and compared against a new medical case.

A set of experts embedded in the embedding space who can be queried and to whom a new case may be communicated for diagnosis.<SEP>A set of medical experts embedded in the embedding space, each embedded based on information such as profile, coded medical procedures, authored articles, and linked stored medical cases.

A user who submits a query request including a new medical case and selects from a plurality of query types.<SEP>The party submitting a query request including a new medical case and selecting from available query types.

A query type that returns a subset of existing cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.<SEP>A query type that returns a subset of existing medical cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.
A query type that returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.

A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from the cost for a query-for-cases.<SEP>A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from and is higher than the cost for a query-for-cases.
A set of medical concepts joined by links, each concept corresponding to a dimension in the multidimensional representation, used to embed cases and experts.

A representation generated in the embedding space for each existing case, each expert, and the new case.<SEP>A representation of a medical case computed based on a medical ontology, used for embedding in the embedding space.
A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology when computing similarity.
A system on which the medical ontology is based.
One of the categories of concepts included in the ontology, alongside biological functions, medical conditions, and pharmacological substances.
One of the categories of concepts included in the ontology.
One of the categories of concepts included in the ontology.
One of the categories of concepts included in the ontology.
Information associated with an expert used for embedding the expert in the embedding space.
Medical procedures performed by an expert, used as information for embedding the expert.
Articles written by an expert, used as information for embedding the expert.

nodes.description: An attribute of an expert that may be used, along with rating and follower count, when returning a subset of experts.
A rating of an expert that may be used when returning a subset of experts.
The number of followers of an expert among users of the system, which may be used when returning a subset of experts.
A database from which documents may be returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and embedded documents when the query-for-cases is selected.
The diagnosis sought for a new case and attempted to be provided by an expert.<SEP>The medical determination formulated by a selected expert for a new case provided to that expert.
A payment made to an expert for formulating a diagnosis when the query-for-experts is selected.

A plurality of records relating to a specific patient that make up the new medical case, including laboratory test results, images, symptom descriptions, monitor results, diagnoses, and prescribed medications and treatments.
Records of laboratory tests that may form part of the new medical case.
Images that may form part of the new medical case.
Descriptions of symptoms that may form part of the new medical case.
Results of patient monitors that may form part of the new medical case.
Records of prescribed medications and treatments that may form part of the new medical case.

A system comprising memory and a processor that provides diagnosis assistance by handling queries for cases and experts.<SEP>A system comprising memory storing instructions for performing the diagnosis assistance method and a processor in communication with the memory for executing the instructions.
A product comprising a non-transitory recording medium storing instructions that when executed on a computer cause it to perform the diagnosis assistance method.
A processor that performs at least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing query cost steps.
A plurality of selectable query types including a query-for-cases and a query-for-experts.
The computation of similarity between the embedded new case and embedded existing cases or embedded experts to determine returned subsets.
A processor in communication with memory that executes the stored instructions.
Memory that stores instructions for receiving queries, embedding cases, providing query types, returning subsets, and computing costs.
A network comprising a diagnosis assistance system and a set of user devices linking requesters and experts with the system.
A set of devices for linking requesters and experts with the diagnosis assistance system.

edges.description: The diagnosis assistance method embeds a new medical case in an embedding space in which existing medical cases and experts are also embedded.
The diagnosis assistance method receives a query request including a new medical case and embeds it in the embedding space.
The method provides a query-by-cases at a first cost.<SEP>The diagnosis assistance method provides for the requester to select a query-for-cases query type.
The method provides a query-by-experts at a second cost higher than the first cost.<SEP>The diagnosis assistance method provides for the requester to select a query-for-experts query type.
The diagnosis assistance system comprises memory storing instructions for performing the diagnosis assistance method and a processor for executing the instructions.
The computer program product stores instructions that when executed on a computer cause it to perform the diagnosis assistance method.
At least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing query cost steps is performed with a computer processor.
The method generates a multidimensional representation for each existing case, each expert, and the new case in the embedding space.
The method computes a cost for the query based on the query type requested.
The new medical case is embedded in an embedding space.
The set of existing medical cases is embedded in the embedding space.
The set of experts is embedded in the embedding space.
The embedding of the new medical case comprises computing a multidimensional representation based on a medical ontology.
The new medical case is embedded via a multidimensional representation computed based on the medical ontology.
The new medical case comprises a plurality of records relating to a specific patient.
The requester submits a query request that includes a new medical case.

When the query-for-cases is selected, a subset of the existing cases is returned based on computed similarity.<SEP>When the query-for-cases is selected, a subset of the existing medical cases is returned based on computed similarity with the embedded new case.
The embedding of the existing medical cases is based on the medical ontology.

When the query-by-experts is requested, the new case is communicated to one of the subset of experts for the expert to attempt to provide a diagnosis.<SEP>When the query-for-experts is selected, a subset of the experts is returned based on computed similarity.<SEP>When the query-for-experts is selected, a subset of the experts is returned based on computed similarity with the embedded new case.
